summary: One model tool that searches the live web through a fallback chain of five upstreams and reports upstream failures verbatim.

configuration.description: Ordered upstream list (bing,duckduckgo,hn,github,npm); an unknown provider name is refused at startup.
Default result count (1-10); the tool argument overrides it.

providers.description: Search provider consumed by the web capability; a different implementation can serve the same port without changing the tool surface.

examples.title: Search the web
examples.description: Call the published tool with a query and an optional result limit.

examples.title: Restrict upstreams
examples.description: Set KEEL_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDERS=hn,github to search only Hacker News and GitHub.

limits.name: total_budget_ms
limits.description: The chain stops once the budget is spent and reports the providers it did not reach.

limits.name: provider_timeout_ms
limits.description: One slow upstream cannot hold the whole chain past this bound.

limits.name: max_results
limits.description: Hard cap on the result count returned to the model.
